briefing.headline: 112 Solid tests near ISS air; cabin pressure assumed

sentences.text: 112 Solid tests recorded O₂ near this query, but PSI did not record cabin pressure; 14.7 psi is a cabin-pressure assumption.
The highest measured O₂ concentration in solid-phase tests is 22.2 %.
Solid-phase tests at 18–25 % O₂ show a 63.6 % burn outcome share.
PMMA is observed to burn in solid-phase tests at 22.1 % O₂ and 14.7 psi.
No measured solid-phase tests exist within the specified 5 % O₂ and 2 psi window for the ISS.

gaps: No solid-phase tests exist above 22.2 % O₂.

next_tests.why: Measure the selected material at the target atmosphere to establish direct Solid coverage.
Compare Silicone with PMMA; the cited Solid results include a different reported outcome.

confidence.reason: The analysis relies on assumed cabin pressure for all solid-phase test data.
